title: PDEAgent-Bench seven-family fixed-adapter snapshot
purpose: Measure how much of the public PDEAgent-Bench contract a single case-identity-independent AgentFEM numerical policy can solve without consuming oracle-only data or generating backend code per case.
physics: Poisson, heat, linear elasticity, Helmholtz, convection--diffusion, reaction--diffusion, and scalar wave equations

execution.command: python scripts/run_benchmark.py --agent gpt-5.1 --solver-path /path/to/agentfem/tools/pdeagent_bench_solver.py --equation-types poisson heat linear_elasticity helmholtz convection_diffusion reaction_diffusion wave --version v2 --output /path/to/evidence
execution.evidence: Local runs of the official v2 runner at PDEAgent-Bench commit 0ba9853f82a78196796fa4eeaf0951eb4c000a00 on 21 August 2026. The agent name satisfies runner validation; solver-path mode does not call that model. Per-family final gates were Poisson 77/91, heat 40/50, linear elasticity 53/63, Helmholtz 52/62, convection--diffusion 68/84, reaction--diffusion 64/64, and wave 42/42.

observables: All 456 cases produced executable, schema-valid outputs through one public fixed adapter.
The official final gate passed 396/456 cases for an 86.8 percent micro-average.
The unweighted seven-family macro-average was 87.6 percent.
Every complete family exceeded 75 percent; reaction--diffusion and wave each passed 100 percent.
Correcting the complete backward-Euler SUPG residual raised convection--diffusion from 64/84 to 68/84.
acceptance: Consume only the official public agent view and never oracle mesh, oracle finite-element order, oracle solver settings, manufactured solution, or case identity.
Require execution, accuracy, and time gates rather than treating process success as a scientific pass.
Require at least 75 percent in every included family and at least 75 percent for both macro- and micro-average scores.
Retain the benchmark commit, AgentFEM source identity, commands, failure taxonomy, and per-family denominators.
limitations: This is a local fixed-adapter development result, not an official leaderboard submission and not a measurement of gpt-5.1.

The public agent view of several three-dimensional manufactured cases is inconsistent with its withheld manufactured solution; AgentFEM follows the exposed equation and does not add case-specific exceptions.
A fixed-adapter score does not establish an AI assistance advantage; that claim requires a same-model, same-budget controlled A/B study.
Temporary official-runner artifacts are not distributed in the Python package; the pinned command and normalized evidence contract are the reproducibility path.
